pages.title: Induction Generator
pages.text: A coil spun inside a permanent magnet's field by a small turbine. Stronger magnets give more power; flowing water beside it spins it faster.$(br2)Generates power.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Burns coal, charcoal or blaze rods to spin its coil, with a magnet in its second slot (never used up). The stronger the magnet the more power - it rises with the square of the field. Flowing water beside it adds half again per side.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (2 item and 0 fluid inputs, 0 and 0 outputs).
